items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names reveal intent (WindowFrameBoundary, assertFrameOffset, buildWindowClause, getPosition). Sections have header comments, the public helpers have JSDoc, and .window() has a docstring with an example. Formatting was checked with dprint and fixed.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: One shared buildWindowClause(windows) is used by all five dialects. Each dialect adds only the optional windows field and a thin 3-line .window() method. Helpers sit in sql/functions/window.ts (~407 lines) and use sql.raw/sql.join. Functions are short.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: assertFrameOffset rejects non-integer or negative values and names the helper. ntile/nthValue reject non-positive values. assertWindowName checks for empty and whitespace-only names. Frames are checked with getPosition and invalid unbounded frames are rejected. No errors are swallowed. One hidden test still failed (129/130).

items.name: Public API additions are additive and consistent across dialects
items.name_zh: 公共 API 新增保持向后兼容且各方言一致
items.evidence: The change only adds things: `export * from './window.ts'`, an optional `windows?: WindowDefinition[]` on all five *SelectConfig types, and the same `window(name, spec = {}): this` on pg/mysql/sqlite/gel/singlestore. The WINDOW chunk is undefined when unused, so existing SQL is unchanged. All 566 existing (pass-to-pass) tests pass.
